objects.description: Forward declaration of the runtime context type used by HILTI runtime internals. Only an incomplete type is declared in this header; its layout and lifetime management are defined elsewhere.

objects.definition:
struct HiltiModule {
    const char* name{};              /**< name of the HILTI module; for informational purposes */
    uint64_t id = 0;                 /**< unique identifier for the module */
    void (*init_module)() = nullptr; /**< callback for executing any top-level module code when the runtime library is
                                being initialized; null if not needed */
    void (*init_globals)(hilti::rt::Context* ctx) =
        nullptr; /**< callback to initialize the module's globals in a freshly allocated context; null if not needed */
    void (*destroy_globals)(hilti::rt::Context* ctx) =
        nullptr; /**< callback to destroy the module's globals at termination; null if not needed */
    unsigned int* globals_idx = nullptr; /**< pointer to an integer storing the modules' index in the context-wide
                                            globals array; valid only if dynamic globals are in use */
};
objects.description: Descriptor for a compiled HILTI module registered with the runtime. Generated code creates one instance per module and passes it to registerModule to hook module lifecycle callbacks into the runtime.

Helper RAII-style class used via a global static instance to execute a supplied no-arg function during static initialization time (unless manual preinit is enabled). The constructor immediately invokes the provided function pointer.

Helper class that, when constructed (typically as a global static), registers a no-arg function to be executed later by hilti::rt::executeManualPreInits when HILTI_MANUAL_PREINIT is enabled. Only the constructor is declared here; implementation is elsewhere.

functions.name: hilti::rt::init
functions.description: Initializes the HILTI runtime library. Call exactly once at process startup before using any other libhilti functionality.
requirements: Must be called exactly once per process startup.
Must be called before any other libhilti/HILTI runtime APIs are used.

functions.name: hilti::rt::done
functions.description: Shuts down the HILTI runtime library and frees all associated resources. After calling this, no libhilti functionality can be used.
requirements: Should be called after hilti::rt::init() when the application is done using the HILTI runtime.
Must not call any libhilti/HILTI runtime APIs after this function completes.

functions.name: hilti::rt::isInitialized
functions.description: Returns true if hilti::rt::init() has already been called; false otherwise. Useful to guard initialization or check runtime state.
requirements: None beyond providing a valid runtime environment; callable at any time to query initialization state.

functions.name: hilti::rt::executeManualPreInits
functions.description: Executes any global functions that were registered via hilti::rt::detail::RegisterManualPreInit. Intended for builds where pre-initialization is performed manually (when HILTI_MANUAL_PREINIT is defined).
requirements: Only needed/has effect when HILTI_MANUAL_PREINIT is defined at build time.
Should be called before functionality that depends on those pre-init functions (as implied by manual pre-init usage).

functions.name: hilti::rt::detail::registerModule
functions.description: Registers a compiled HILTI module with the runtime. The HILTI code generator emits calls to this function for each compiled module so the runtime can initialize and manage module-level code and globals.
requirements: The module argument must describe a valid hilti::rt::detail::HiltiModule instance.
module.name is informational; can be null or a valid C-string per typical usage (not explicitly required).
module.id is intended to be a unique identifier for the module.
module.init_module may be null; if non-null it must point to a valid function taking no arguments and returning void.
module.init_globals may be null; if non-null it must point to a valid function taking hilti::rt::Context* and returning void.
module.destroy_globals may be null; if non-null it must point to a valid function taking hilti::rt::Context* and returning void.
module.globals_idx may be null; if non-null it must point to an unsigned int used as the module index when dynamic globals are in use (valid only if dynamic globals are in use).
